svg.text: Ring all-reduce as simulated by simulate_ring.py (W = 3)
Each cell lists whose data is already summed into that rank's copy of that chunk. Rows are ranks, columns are chunks.
every rank sends to rank r+1
Phase 1: reduce-scatter, W−1 = 2 steps (repeat for s = 0 … W−2)
Phase 2: all-gather, W−1 = 2 steps (repeat for s = 0 … W−2)
each rank holds only its own data
send chunk (r − s) mod W → rank r+1
recv chunk (r − s − 1) mod W ← rank r−1
receiver ADDS it to its own copy
send chunk (r − s) mod W → rank r+1
recv chunk (r − s − 1) mod W ← rank r−1
receiver ADDS it to its own copy
send chunk (r + 1 − s) mod W → rank r+1
recv chunk (r − s) mod W ← rank r−1
send chunk (r + 1 − s) mod W → rank r+1
recv chunk (r − s) mod W ← rank r−1
rank r owns the fully reduced chunk (r + 1) mod W
owners of the dark cells above:
rank 0 → chunk 1, rank 1 → chunk 2, rank 2 → chunk 0
assert every cell = {0,1,2}: each rank counted once
result: every rank holds the full sum
